{{- /* Explicit reading order for MILGRAU documentation. */ -}} {{- $current := . -}} {{- $pages := where site.RegularPages "Section" $current.Section -}} {{- $pages = $pages.ByWeight -}} {{- $previous := false -}} {{- $following := false -}} {{- range $i, $page := $pages -}} {{- if eq $page.RelPermalink $current.RelPermalink -}} {{- if gt $i 0 -}} {{- $previous = index $pages (sub $i 1) -}} {{- end -}} {{- if lt (add $i 1) (len $pages) -}} {{- $following = index $pages (add $i 1) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if or $previous $following -}}
{{- with $previous -}}

navigate_before {{ .Title }}

{{- if site.Params.docs.navDesc -}}

{{ .Description | truncate (site.Params.docs.navDescTrunc | default 65) }}

{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- with $following -}}

{{ .Title }} navigate_next

{{- if site.Params.docs.navDesc -}}

{{ .Description | truncate (site.Params.docs.navDescTrunc | default 65) }}

{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
